analysis_walkthrough.business_objective_summary: Ensure that contract owners in the system are correctly defined as canonical macro names, matching the declared containers.
requirements_understanding: The objective is to verify and ensure consistency between contract owner names and their respective containers.
This involves checking that all contract owner identifiers are standardized and correctly mapped.
conversion_to_technical_requirements: Implement validation logic to check the consistency of contract owner names.
Develop a reporting mechanism to identify mismatches between macro names and containers.
clarifications_requested: What are the specific containers referenced in the business objective?

executive_summary: This project focuses on verifying and ensuring that contract owner identifiers are correctly standardized and mapped to their containers.

functional_requirements.title: Validate Contract Owner Names
functional_requirements.description: Ensure all contract owner names are canonical and match their declared containers.
acceptance_criteria: All contract owner names must follow the defined canonical naming convention.
Mismatch reports should be generated for any inconsistencies found.
Validation should occur during both data entry and batch processing.

functional_requirements.title: Generate Mismatch Reports
functional_requirements.description: Create reports detailing any mismatches between contract owner names and their containers.
acceptance_criteria: Reports must include details of the mismatched names and their expected containers.
Reports should be accessible to system administrators.
Reports must be generated on-demand and scheduled intervals.

functional_requirements.title: Standardize Naming Conventions
functional_requirements.description: Define and enforce a standard naming convention for contract owners.
acceptance_criteria: Naming conventions must be documented and approved by stakeholders.
System must enforce naming conventions during data entry.
Existing data must be audited and corrected to meet new standards.

functional_requirements.title: Container Mapping Verification
functional_requirements.description: Verify that each contract owner is correctly mapped to its declared container.
acceptance_criteria: Mapping logic must be reviewed and approved by domain experts.
Automated checks should flag incorrect mappings.
Manual overrides must be logged and reviewed.

functional_requirements.title: Error Handling for Validation Failures
functional_requirements.description: Implement error handling for validation failures in contract owner naming.
acceptance_criteria: Errors must be logged with sufficient detail for troubleshooting.
Users must receive clear feedback on validation failures.
System should allow retry after correcting errors.

functional_requirements.title: User Interface for Name Management
functional_requirements.description: Provide a user interface for managing and reviewing contract owner names.
acceptance_criteria: UI must allow users to view and edit contract owner names.
Changes must be logged with user and timestamp information.
UI should provide search and filter capabilities for contract owners.

non_functional_requirements.title: Security of Name Management
non_functional_requirements.description: Ensure that contract owner name management is secure against unauthorized access.
non_functional_requirements.metric: All access to name management must be authenticated and authorized.
acceptance_criteria: Access logs must be maintained for all name management actions.
System must enforce role-based access control.
Security audits must be conducted quarterly.

blocking.question: Target application architecture for the modernization
blocking.default_recommendation: Start with a modular monolith unless there is a clear reason to decompose immediately.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Early coupling / drift that is expensive to correct downstream.

blocking.question: Database contract strategy during migration
blocking.default_recommendation: Preserve contracts initially and modernize behind a compatibility layer.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Business rule drift and data-side regressions.

blocking.impact_if_wrong: Authorization regressions and lost session context during cutover.
